import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('SoBanHang_1.xlsx', sheet_name='Thang 09 2025')

def parse_vn_number(val):
    if isinstance(val, (int, float)):
        return float(val)
    s = str(val).strip().replace('.', '').replace(',', '').replace('đ', '').replace('Đ', '')
    if s.endswith('k'):
        s = s[:-1]
        return float(s) * 1000
    return float(s)

df['tri_gia'] = df['Trị giá'].apply(parse_vn_number)
df['order'] = df['Mã hóa đơn']

# order-level aggregates
orders = df.groupby('order').agg(
    has_negative=('tri_gia', lambda s: (s < 0).any()),
    total_tri_gia=('tri_gia', 'sum'),
    n_lines=('tri_gia', 'count'),
).reset_index()

status_map = df.groupby('order')['Status'].first().to_dict()
orders['status'] = orders['order'].map(status_map)

# classify
cancelled = orders[orders['status'].isin(['hủy', 'Đã hủy đơn'])]
returned_status = orders[orders['status'].isin(['Trả hàng', 'Hoàn trả', 'Đổi trả', 'hàng trả về'])]
print("orders total:", len(orders))
print("cancelled (status):", len(cancelled))
print("returned (status):", len(returned_status))
print()

# returns by negative quantity
neg_orders = orders[orders['has_negative']]
print("orders with negative qty line:", len(neg_orders))
print("  of which status is return:", len(neg_orders[neg_orders['status'].isin(['Trả hàng','Hoàn trả','Đổi trả','hàng trả về'])]))
print("  of which status is NOT return:", len(neg_orders[~neg_orders['status'].isin(['Trả hàng','Hoàn trả','Đổi trả','hàng trả về'])]))
print()

# valid orders = not cancelled, not returned (by status or negative qty)
valid = orders[
    (~orders['status'].isin(['hủy','Đã hủy đơn'])) &
    (~orders['status'].isin(['Trả hàng','Hoàn trả','Đổi trả','hàng trả về'])) &
    (~orders['has_negative'])
]
print("valid orders:", len(valid))
print("valid order statuses:", valid['status'].value_counts(dropna=False))
print()
print("Total revenue (sum trị giá of valid orders):", round(valid['total_tri_gia'].sum()))
print()
# sanity: what if we just sum all positive trị giá lines?
all_pos = df[df['tri_gia'] > 0]['tri_gia'].sum()
print("sum of all positive trị giá lines (all orders):", round(all_pos))
